payload.text: The Brennecke Institute originated the thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery, whose dopant suppresses electrolyte crossover. An independent audit corrected its cycle life to 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee, retracting the earlier 12,000-cycle claim. The cell achieved 148 Wh/kg, with a projected stack-level cost of $61/kWh at 500 MWh manufacturing scale. Cycling must be suspended below 4 °C because the dopant precipitates from the negative electrolyte.
